title: Binary contracted product presentation
statement: Let $X$ be a scheme [def-pc-scheme], $G$ an abelian sheaf on its small Zariski site [def-sc-zariski-site], and $P,Q,R$ $G$-torsors [def-sc-gm-torsor]. A binary contracted product presentation of $R=P\wedge Q$ consists of natural maps $q_U:P(U)\times Q(U)\to R(U)$ invariant under $(x,y)\mapsto(g\cdot x,(-g)\cdot y)$, equivariant for the residual $G$-action from the first factor, with the following sheaf quotient universal property: for every sheaf of sets $F$, every natural invariant family $a_U:P(U)\times Q(U)\to F(U)$ factors uniquely as $a=f\circ q$ for a sheaf morphism $f:R\to F$.

source.place: Worker's argument developing the contracted-product group law of node lem-sc-torsor-h1; the coherent integer-power construction is not in Stacks 02FQ
